bannerSubtitle: Applications are being accepted for LKG to Class X.

processSteps.title: Collect Application Form
processSteps.description: Obtain the application form from the school office or download it from our website.

processSteps.title: Submit Documents
processSteps.description: Submit the completed form along with all required documents to the school office.

processSteps.title: Entrance Assessment
processSteps.description: Students appear for a simple aptitude assessment (Class III and above).

processSteps.title: Interview & Confirmation
processSteps.description: Parents and student meet with the Principal. Seat is confirmed upon fee payment.

documents: Previous year report card / mark sheet
